CNG prices rose in nine of 13 locations and held steady in four; Chennai,  Sounak Mukhopadhyay Published 22 Oct 2026, 07:04 AM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Fuel prices today: Check petrol, diesel and CNG rates on 22 October in different cities across India ( Pexels ) AI Quick Read Petrol and diesel prices remained unchanged across 14 cities on 22 October. CNG prices rose in nine locations while four locations recorded no change. Chennai, Mathura and Meerut recorded the biggest CNG increases, at ₹ 2 each. Petrol and diesel prices today New Delhi’s petrol price stood at ₹ 102.12 while diesel cost ₹ 95.20. Kolkata recorded petrol at ₹ 113.51 and diesel at ₹ 99.82. In Mumbai, petrol cost ₹ 111.21 while diesel stood at ₹ 97.83. Chennai’s petrol price was ₹ 107.76, with diesel at ₹ 99.55. Gurugram recorded petrol at ₹ 102.97 and diesel at ₹ 95.64. Noida’s petrol price stood at ₹ 101.96 while diesel cost ₹ 95.44. Lucknow recorded petrol at ₹ 101.86 and diesel at ₹ 95.36. Chandigarh had petrol at ₹ 101.54 and diesel at ₹ 89.47. Also Read | Centre cuts windfall tax on diesel exports, raises levy on petrol Among these 14 cities, Chandigarh had the lowest petrol and diesel prices . Hyderabad recorded the highest petrol price, at ₹ 116.15. Its diesel price stood at ₹ 104.23. Thiruvananthapuram had the highest diesel price, at ₹ 104.40. Petrol in Thiruvananthapuram cost ₹ 115.49. Bengaluru’s petrol price stood at ₹ 111.68 while diesel cost ₹ 99.56. Bhubaneswar recorded petrol at ₹ 108.97 and diesel at ₹ 100.68. Jaipur’s petrol price was ₹ 113.19, with diesel at ₹ 98.25. Patna recorded petrol at ₹ 113.37 and diesel at ₹ 99.36. Petrol prices exceeded ₹ 100 in all 14 cities. Diesel prices crossed ₹ 100 in Bhubaneswar, Hyderabad and Thiruvananthapuram. The gap between Hyderabad’s and Chandigarh’s petrol prices was ₹ 14.61. Thiruvananthapuram’s diesel price exceeded Chandigarh’s by ₹ 14.93. Also Read | Insurance claims for repairs of EV may cost more than for petrol, diesel cars CNG prices today For CNG , Mumbai’s price rose by ₹ 1 to ₹ 89.00. Chennai recorded a ₹ 2 increase, taking its price to ₹ 99.50. Bengaluru’s CNG price increased by ₹ 1 to ₹ 98.00. New Delhi’s CNG price remained unchanged at ₹ 86.98. Hyderabad’s CNG price stayed at ₹ 112.00, the highest among the 13 locations. Rewari recorded no change, with CNG priced at ₹ 91.59. NCR’s CNG price also remained unchanged at ₹ 86.98. New Delhi and NCR shared the lowest CNG price among these locations. Also Read | Rubio to visit Reliance Industries’ Jamnagar facilities - What is on the agenda Bharatpur’s CNG price rose by 50 paise to ₹ 98.00. Dewas recorded the same increase, taking its price to ₹ 98.00. Firozabad’s CNG price increased by 50 paise to ₹ 99.50. Mathura recorded a ₹ 2 rise, with CNG reaching ₹ 102.00. Meerut’s CNG price rose by ₹ 2 to ₹ 95.50. Sonipat recorded a ₹ 1 increase, taking its CNG price to ₹ 95.00. None of the 13 locations recorded a CNG price cut. For CNG, Hyderabad’s price exceeded New Delhi’s by ₹ 25.02. Chennai and Firozabad had the same CNG price of ₹ 99.50. Bengaluru, Bharatpur, and Dewas also shared the same CNG price.
